name: (Ne)Real'nost'
source:
Welcome!
Would you like to play the ukulele in the void? Enjoy some barbeque, paid for with a story? Travel through the memories of the main character? Then you're most welcome to play this game!

Just… try not to die.
translation:
欢迎！
你想在虚空中弹奏尤克里里吗？享受一些烧烤，并用故事付费？穿越主角的记忆？那么非常欢迎你来玩这个游戏！

只是……尽量不要死。
